explainer.heading: UV restarts pigment production faster than any ingredient can soften it
body: This is why every routine on this site ends with a sun protection step, and why we say plainly that a routine without one is not worth high expectations.
Light through a window and blue light from a screen are weaker than direct sun, but they are present through the whole working day. It is the total exposure time that adds up.

blocks.heading: Seven filters, each one named
blocks.intro: Five chemical filters absorb UV; two physical filters reflect it. Most sunscreens print “sun protection technology” and stop there.
blocks.caption: This table lists the filters by the INCI names the manufacturer publishes, together with the conditioning actives PRINTED ON THE 50g TUBE. Full INCI list is printed on the packaging.

rows.name: Octocrylene
rows.role: Absorbs UVB and stabilises the other filters.

rows.name: Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate
rows.role: Absorbs UVB; the most widely used filter in its class.

rows.name: Zinc Oxide
rows.role: Reflects and scatters UV at the skin surface, broad spectrum.

rows.name: Titanium Dioxide
rows.role: Reflects UV, usually paired with zinc oxide.

rows.name: EpiOn™
rows.role: Biotech active, printed on the tube.

rows.name: Niacinamide
rows.role: Supports the skin barrier and evenness of tone.

rows.name: Vitamin E
rows.role: Antioxidant, commonly paired with chemical filters.

rows.name: Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract
rows.role: Centella extract, aimed at calming the skin.

rows.name: Glycyrrhiza Glabra Root Extract
rows.role: Liquorice root extract, aimed at evening out tone.

blocks.heading: Two steps in the morning, one at night
blocks.intro: The order below is taken from the manufacturer's instructions.

items.heading: Cleanse
items.body: Wash your face and dry it.

items.heading: Dot on five points
items.body: Forehead, nose, chin and both cheeks, then spread out. Dotting first spreads more evenly than rubbing out from one spot.

items.heading: Remove it properly at night
items.body: Sunscreen needs thorough removal at the end of the day; a face wash alone is often not enough.

blocks.footnote: Reapply every few hours if you are outdoors continuously, sweating heavily, or in water. One morning application does not last a full day in the sun.

items.a: {{price}} for the 50g tube. The list price is {{compareAtPrice}}. Free delivery, pay on delivery.
It uses both filter families. Chemical filters absorb UV and convert it to heat; physical filters reflect UV at the skin surface. Combining them allows less of each while keeping broad coverage.

items.q: Will it feel heavy on oily skin?
items.a: The manufacturer positions it for oily and combination skin with a light texture. How it feels still varies by person — if every sunscreen has felt heavy to you, try a small amount first.

items.q: Can I use it on skin that has just been peeled?
items.a: The manufacturer positions it for post-peel skin as well. Even so, skin after a procedure is a medical situation: ask whoever performed it.
Keep away from heat and direct sunlight, close the cap after use, keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with the eyes; if it gets in, rinse immediately with clean water.
